content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends a blood pressure target of less than 130/80 mmHg, provided it can be achieved safely. This recommendation aligns with guidelines established by the American College of Cardiology and other cardiovascular societies. Evidence from randomized clinical trials, such as the SPRINT and ACCORD studies, supports the use of intensive blood pressure management in high-risk individuals. These trials demonstrated significant reductions in cardiovascular events when lower blood pressure targets were achieved.
